About.title: About TIA
About.storyBody: TIA was founded on a simple belief: that fine jewelry should feel both timeless and personal. Every piece in our collection is chosen for its lasting quality, understated elegance, and the way it makes the person wearing it feel — confident, cherished, and beautifully herself.
About.valuesBody: From bracelets and rings to earrings and watches, we curate pieces that are meant to be worn and loved for years to come — never fleeting trends, always enduring style. Quality, craftsmanship, and genuine care for our customers guide everything we do.
About.closingBody: Whether you are shopping for a special occasion or an everyday treasure, we are grateful you chose TIA. We would love to hear from you — reach out anytime.
About.storyTitle: Jewellery Made to Become Part of You
About.value2Body: Carefully selected pieces with attention to detail.
About.value3Body: Jewellery designed to become part of everyday moments.
About.statementLine2: Made to be part of you.”

AdminTeam.title: Team
AdminTeam.intro: People who can sign in to this dashboard. Owners manage the team; admins manage the store.
AdminTeam.readOnly: You can view the team. Only an owner can add, change or remove admins.

add.title: Add an admin
add.help: The person must first create an account on the store with their own email and password. You never see or set their password.
add.alreadyStaff: This account is already on the team as {role}.
add.disabled: This account is disabled and can't be given admin access.

confirm.grantBody: {email} will be able to manage products, orders and customers. They'll need to sign in again.
confirm.promoteBody: {email} will be able to add, change and remove admins and owners — including you. They'll need to sign in again.
confirm.demoteBody: {email} keeps admin access but can no longer manage the team. They'll be signed out and must sign in again.
confirm.removeBody: {email} will lose all access to this dashboard immediately. Their store account stays as a normal customer account.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only an owner can manage the admin team.
errors.SELF_CHANGE: You can't change your own role. Ask another owner.
errors.NO_CHANGE: This account already has that role.
errors.LAST_OWNER: This is the last owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.NOT_FOUND: No account exists with that email. Ask them to register on the store first.
errors.BUSY: Another team change is in progress. Try again in a moment.
errors.CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The email you typed doesn't match this account.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
